headline: Defence Ministry signs Rs 4,106 crore deals for IAF and Navy

summary: The Ministry of Defence has finalized contracts worth Rs 4,106 crore to bolster the capabilities of the Indian Air Force and the Indian Navy. The procurement includes an indigenous GSAT-7C communication satellite and Varunastra heavyweight torpedoes. These acquisitions are part of the government's push to modernize military hardware through domestic manufacturing. The deals aim to enhance communication infrastructure and underwater combat readiness.
